## About
[Official documentation](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-water-layer)

The **High Resolution Water Layer (HRWL)** product provides classified maps showing permanent water, temporary water, dry areas, and sea water. It is a multi-annual product, typically covering a **7-year period**, and is updated every 3 years. It is based on the annual Water Cover Duration (WCD) production, which combines water masks from **Sentinel-1** radar and **Sentinel-2** optical imagery with Water/Ice Cover data from Sentinel-2 (WIC S2).<br><br>The product is generated at the European scale with a spatial resolution of **10 m × 10 m**.<br><br>**Data availability**: HRWL is available for the reference years 2021 and 2024, covering the periods **01/09/2016**–31/12/2021 and **01/09/2018**–31/12/2024, respectively. The dataset can be downloaded in multiple projections and pixel spacings.<br><br>More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-water-layer).

[View this dataset in Copernicus Browser](https://browser.dataspace.copernicus.eu/?zoom=10&lat=41.82019&lng=12.57866&themeId=DEFAULT-THEME&datasetId=COPERNICUS_CLMS_WSI_HIGH-RESOLUTION-WATER-LAYER_EUROPE_LAEA_10M_3YEARLY_V1&clmsSelectedPath=Water%20Extent&clmsSelectedCollection=COPERNICUS_CLMS_WSI_HIGH-RESOLUTION-WATER-LAYER_EUROPE_LAEA_10M_3YEARLY_V1) (Click on 'Show latest date' after the page loads.)

## Evalscript

**[Example scripts for this product.](https://github.com/eu-cdse/sentinel-hub-custom-scripts/tree/main/clms/bio-geophysical-parameters/water-bodies/water-extent/clms_wsi_high-resolution-water-layer_europe_laea_10m_3yearly_v1)**

Use the link above to access dedicated Evalscript examples for this product in the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem Sentinel Hub Custom Scripts repository.

An Evalscript (or "custom script") is a piece of Javascript code which defines how the data shall be processed by Sentinel Hub and what values the service shall return. It is a required part of any [process](/APIs/SentinelHub/Process.qmd), [batch processing](/APIs/SentinelHub/BatchV2.qmd) or [OGC request](/APIs/SentinelHub/OGC.qmd).

Evalscripts can use any JavaScript function or language structures, along with certain [utility functions](/APIs/SentinelHub/Evalscript/Functions.qmd) we provide for your convenience. For running evalscripts we use the [Chrome V8](https://v8.dev/){target="_blank"} JavaScript engine.
